p01.why: B has a defined lip line with two fangs and a chest and shoulder mass that tapers into the forelegs in the front view; A has loose star-shaped teeth floating under the jaw and a plain oval torso on thin straight legs.

p02.why: A's head shows a clear mouth slit with lips and a row of small teeth; B's teeth are stars hanging under the nose with no clear mouth. A's round scales have black pixel speckle on the head and front, so this is a narrow call.

p03.why: B adds abdomen segment lines and jointed leg bands, so the body and legs read as insect anatomy; A is a smooth glossy blob with featureless legs. Silhouette and spots are identical.

p04.why: A has a tapered, snake-shaped head and clean polygonal scales. B's head is a flat mushroom cap that is wider than the neck in the front view, and its scale discs carry black speckle noise.

p05.why: A has a readable mouth line with a row of small teeth and a clear jaw. B's head shows almost no mouth, just a smooth chin, so the horned face looks blank. Torso and limbs are near identical (B's legs are slightly better separated).

p06.why: B has a mouth slit with a row of small teeth plus fangs, a neck crease under the head and slightly shaped thighs. A's fangs just hang under a black muzzle with no mouth line.

p07.why: A's head has a clean lower jaw and lip with tidy tile scales. B's disc scales show black speckle and jaggies around the nostril and eye, and its mouth is a thinner line. Narrow call.

p08.why: B has a visible mouth line across the muzzle and a smooth chin. A has no mouth at all and a jagged sawtooth colour edge on the chin. B has a dark stripe under the tusk.

p09.why: Near tie. A's head and neck have clean tile scales and a visible nostril and lip. B's round scales speckle with white and black dots on the neck and head.

p10.why: A's tail, claws and legs are banded into segments and the head has a mandible and teeth line, so it reads as a scorpion. B is a smooth, featureless noodle with no mouth and no segmentation.

p11.why: A's front view shows a closed mouth with a tooth row and two fangs. B's head has a big dark gaping hole with floating star teeth. A's disc scales do show some speckle.

p12.why: In A's front view the thighs bulge from the hips and taper to the shins. B's legs are straight stilts with no thigh mass. A's head has a mouth with a row of teeth along the jaw.

p13.why: B has a clear mouth line along the muzzle with upper-lip teeth and fangs. A's teeth just dangle under the jaw and there is no mouth line. Bodies and claws are identical.

p14.why: B has a mouth slit and lip on the face, and spots on the legs and tail as well as the body. A has a sawtooth cream and tan edge on the chin and face that looks like painted teeth, and bare legs and tail.

p15.why: B has eyelid rims around the eyes and a lower-jaw mouth line with teeth. A's face has no mouth and flat, lidless eyes. Bodies and feet are identical.

p16.why: A's abdomen has segment lines, its thorax is divided and its legs have joint bands, so it reads as an ant. B is a smooth blob and has a ragged seam line on the underside of the head.

p17.why: A has heavy eyelids and a grin line with tiny teeth. B's eyes are plain yellow spheres and its mouth is a ragged zigzag colour boundary with no real mouth.

p18.why: Near tie. B's polygonal scales are clean, while A's disc scales show heavy black pixel speckle on the head and neck. Silhouette, hood and fangs are the same.

p19.why: B's plated polygon skin reads as rhino armour and is clean. A's overlapping disc scales are dotted with black speckle across the head and shoulders. Silhouette and horns are identical.

p20.why: B has a clear mouth slit with lip and teeth, and the red eyes have lid rims. A's mouth is only a row of loose star teeth, and its eyes are bare spheres.
